body: - Addition of "itzsenu mode" where you can block annoying people and never see anything they say or do
- Support for LowEndSpirit has been added

- New OG design: the original LowEndTalk layout with BetterLET features and a dark theme
- One gear beside the search box for design, theme, and signatures
- New Dashboard page with your counts, threads, and bookmarks
- Thanks button beside Quote on every post
- Links to other sites open in a new tab
- Signatures show by default, with an option to collapse them
- Cleaner polls, page numbers, and quotes in previews
- Fixed the reply box growing after Preview
- Update alerts and one-click updates
